cohort: 10 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Wuhan, China, between January 23 and February 23, 2020.
finding: All 10 pregnant women with mild COVID-19 had live births without neonatal asphyxia, suggesting COVID-19 may not be an indication for cesarean section, but pulmonary CT screening on admission may be necessary to reduce nosocomial transmission.
mod_finding: Of the 10 women, 2 had vaginal deliveries, 2 had intrapartum cesarean sections, and 6 had elective cesarean sections.
